formats.key: Permit(address owner,address spender,uint256 value,uint256 nonce,uint256 deadline)
effects: Once anyone submits this signature, the spender's allowance over the owner's amDAI (Aave Polygon v2 aDAI) is set to `value`. This replaces any earlier allowance.
The spender can then move up to `value` amDAI out of the owner's balance with transferFrom, until the allowance is used up or changed.
The signature can only be submitted up to `deadline`.
Submitting it uses up the owner's current permit nonce, so any other signed permit with the same nonce stops working.
formats.shown: The screen says "Authorize spending of tokens" and lists the spender as a hex address, the maximum amount in amDAI ("Unlimited" at 2^255 or more), the expiry date and the owner.

findings.title: Permit has no interpolatedIntent, so the intent line leaves out the token, amount and spender.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json: the Permit format has only "intent": "Authorize spending of tokens" and no interpolatedIntent. Case 0: the screen intent is the generic line, while the amount (2500 amDAI) and the spender 0xE592… appear only in the fields.
findings.fix: Add "interpolatedIntent": "Allow {spender} to spend up to {value} until {deadline}".
